claims.meaning: POI is a tested typed support/resistance interest zone; not automatically any 4H/1D candle wick range.
4H/1H POI roles include IMB, SNR, RB and liquidity; POI must be tested before VC route is considered.
In course methodology the first POI test matters; repeated tests can accumulate liquidity, so do not silently treat repeated touch as pristine.
RB candidate requires liquidity raid or overlap/cover of IMB, not just adjacent two opposite-color candles.
A SNR level source reaction/VC differs from RB and needs its specific source interaction.
4H POI test with 1H liquidity or IMB trigger: evaluate 15M IMB/SNR VC for entry.
Without 1H trigger after 4H POI test or after 4H liquidity raid, wait for 1H VC and treat 1H VC POI as new support context.
After a properly contextual 1H POI test and 15M trigger, look for 5M VC IMB/SNR entry.
Without 15M trigger after contextual 1H POI test, 15M VC IMB/SNR may become the entry POI.
4H base POI and 1H VC target on 4H FTA; 1H POI and 15M VC target on 1H FTA. Author FTA geometry still requires original examples.
At entry VC is IMB or SNR, although contextual VC/POI can include RB; conflating RB entry with route A IMB/SNR is unsupported.
4H contextual VC POI can set up 1H IDM entry; 1H VC POI can set up 15M IDM entry.
IDM is BSL/SSL lower-TF liquidity inside or ahead of the contextual POI and may enter directly at trigger without final raid VC; must be supported by strong HL.
1H fractal wick raid and 3M/5M BOS; if BSL raid BOS below raid, if SSL raid BOS above raid.

1H BOS route stop behind raided liquidity, target on raid's TF; without BOS or meaningful nearest FTA/acceptable RR skip. Neither C39 retrospective close nor C44 prior candle range alone constitutes executable trade.
A Strong High/Low requires liquidity/inefficiency contact and subsequent POI or BOS confirmation; bare pivot is insufficient for academic SL.

Lesson text yields conditional requirements, but chart screenshots and archived 2023 entry/stop/target examples have not been independently aligned to original candle raw IDs; no positive author golden asserted.
